name: Dyna
zh: 同一学习器既消费真实转移，也消费模型模拟的转移。模型的价值是让一次真实经验被多用几次，不是生成画面。
en: The learner updates from both experienced and model-generated transitions. The point is to reuse real experience, not to generate pictures.

name: World Models
zh: 视觉编码器压缩画面，循环模型预测潜状态，小控制器读出动作。控制器在梦中找到的捷径未必存在于真实环境。
en: A visual encoder compresses frames; a recurrent model predicts latent dynamics; a small controller acts. A shortcut found inside the dream need not exist in the environment.

name: PlaNet
zh: 从像素学习带记忆的潜状态，在里面比较候选动作序列，执行第一步再规划。速度与搜索预算直接相关。
en: Learn a recurrent latent state from pixels, compare candidate action sequences in that state, execute the first step and replan. Search costs time at each decision.

name: Dreamer
zh: 在模型想象的轨迹上训练策略和价值函数，把规划的部分成本移到训练期。部署时无需每步穷举未来。
en: Train an actor and value function on imagined latent trajectories. This shifts work to training rather than searching over futures at every decision.

name: MuZero
zh: 只学习搜索需要的奖励、价值和策略先验，用树搜索择步；不要求重建棋盘或游戏画面。
en: Learn reward, value and policy priors for tree search rather than reconstructing the board or screen. Accuracy is tied to the decision task.

name: DreamerV3
zh: 沿用潜空间想象，用归一化等稳定化设计跨域训练。多种控制环境的证据不能直接外推到家务机器人。
en: Normalization and other stabilizers make latent imagination work across diverse control domains. That breadth is not a household-robot trial.

name: TD-MPC2
zh: 在任务导向潜空间做短视野规划，再用终端价值估计更远的回报；无需让每个像素都可解码。
en: Plan short trajectories in a task-oriented latent space and use terminal value to estimate what lies beyond. Pixel reconstruction is not required.

name: Genie
zh: 从无动作标签的视频学习离散潜动作，再按潜动作生成交互轨迹；可玩按钮不等于机器人的关节指令。
en: Infer discrete latent actions from videos without action labels, then condition an interactive generator on them. A playable button is not a calibrated robot command.

name: DIAMOND
zh: 直接扩散生成动作条件画面，并在生成环境里训练 Atari 策略。小物体细节影响得分，但游戏不是实物接触。
en: Generate action-conditioned pixels with diffusion and train an Atari policy in the resulting environment. Small details affect score; game dynamics are not physical contact.

name: V-JEPA 2 / 2-AC
zh: 先从无动作视频预测特征，再固定编码器、用机器人交互训练动作条件预测器，以目标图像特征做规划。Hub 链接是视频编码器，不是完整控制器。
en: First predict video features; freeze the encoder and train an action-conditioned predictor on robot interactions for goal-image planning. The linked Hub card is the video encoder, not the controller.

name: Cosmos World Foundation Model Platform
zh: 把生成式视频先验做成可适配的平台；给出提示或视频条件不等同于精确遵循机器人动作。
en: Package generative video priors for downstream adaptation. Conditioning on prompts or video alone does not establish sensitivity to precise robot actions.

name: Room-to-Room / VLN
zh: 把自然语言路线与室内视点图配对，评估智能体能否走到目标。图上的可走边不等于真实底盘动力学。
en: Pair natural-language routes with indoor viewpoint graphs and ask whether an agent reaches the goal. Traversable graph edges are not mobile-base dynamics.

name: Habitat
zh: 用可配置传感器、任务和三维模拟器研究在环导航；模拟器提供环境，不是智能体自己学出的世界模型。
en: Configurable sensors, tasks and a 3D simulator enable closed-loop navigation experiments. The simulator supplies the environment; the agent did not learn it.

name: Learning to Walk in Minutes
zh: 用大量并行模拟环境训练四足运动策略，再迁移到真机。这是具身策略，但策略不必预测下一帧。
en: Train locomotion policies in many parallel simulated environments, then transfer to hardware. This is embodied learning without requiring next-frame prediction.

name: SayCan
zh: 语言模型判断哪个技能符合指令，价值函数判断当前能否完成，再调用已有技能。技能库外的动作不会自动出现。
en: Combine language-based usefulness with a learned feasibility score, then execute an existing skill. The planner cannot summon actions absent from its skill library.

name: RT-1
zh: 把图像和指令编码后预测离散化机器人动作；覆盖许多任务不等于掌握任意新硬件的控制接口。
en: Encode images and instructions to predict discretized actions. Task breadth does not confer a control interface for arbitrary new hardware.

name: RT-2
zh: 把动作编码成文本符号，将机器人示范与视觉语言任务一起微调。语义迁移不证明获得了精确的物理预测器。
en: Encode actions as text tokens and co-fine-tune on robot demonstrations and vision-language tasks. Semantic transfer is not proof of precise physical prediction.

name: ACT / ALOHA
zh: 从低成本双臂示范学习成段的关节动作，对重叠预测做时间集成以稳定动作。效果依赖示范和控制接口。
en: Learn joint-action chunks from low-cost bimanual demonstrations and ensemble overlapping predictions over time. Results depend on demonstrations and the control interface.

name: Diffusion Policy
zh: 对动作序列而非世界画面去噪，能表达绕物体左走或右走等多种解；只执行一段便重新观测。
en: Denoise action sequences rather than images of the future. Multiple routes around an object can coexist; execute a prefix before observing again.

name: Octo
zh: 用多机器人轨迹训练可适配不同观测和动作空间的通用策略；新接口仍可能需要微调。
en: Pretrain a generalist policy on cross-robot trajectories and adapt input/output interfaces. New embodiments can still require fine-tuning.

name: OpenVLA
zh: 融合视觉特征，用语言模型输出离散动作。运行权重之前，先核对动作反归一化统计对应哪台机器人。
en: Fuse visual features and generate discrete robot actions with a language model. Check the embodiment-specific unnormalization statistics before interpreting its outputs.

name: π0
zh: 在视觉语言骨干旁加入流匹配动作专家，生成连续动作块；相同语言指令仍需对应具体坐标系。
en: Attach a flow-matching action expert to a vision-language backbone to generate continuous action chunks. Instructions still need a concrete coordinate frame.

name: π0.5
zh: 结合异构数据、高层子任务与低层动作，研究未见家庭环境中的指令执行；新家庭并不等于任意新本体。
en: Combine heterogeneous data, high-level subtasks and low-level actions for instructions in unseen homes. An unseen home is not an arbitrary unseen embodiment.

name: SmolVLA
zh: 用紧凑的视觉语言动作模型和异步执行降低实验门槛；测延迟时要包含相机、推理和控制的端到端链路。
en: A compact VLA and asynchronous execution lower the barrier to experiments. Measure latency across camera, inference and control, not just the forward pass.

name: Open X-Embodiment / RT-X
zh: 汇集不同机器人数据，比较共享预训练的迁移收益。统一存储格式不会自动统一坐标、频率与夹爪语义。
en: Pool datasets across robots to study transfer from shared training. A common storage format does not align coordinates, control rates or gripper semantics.

name: LIBERO
zh: 按空间、物体、目标等划分操作任务，研究终身学习与知识迁移。应交代套件与任务顺序，不只报均值。
en: Group manipulation tasks by spatial, object and goal variation to study lifelong transfer. Report the suite and task order, not just a pooled average.

name: DROID
zh: 用标准化硬件从多个站点收集真实轨迹，让背景和操作员更多样。站点多不等于机型多。
en: Collect real trajectories across sites using standardized hardware to diversify scenes and operators. Many sites do not mean many robot types.

name: SIMPLER
zh: 用成对仿真和真机实验校准策略评测；关注排序及其偏差。一个设置下相关，不保证换夹爪后还相关。
en: Calibrate simulated policy evaluation with paired real trials. Correlated rankings on one setup do not establish correlation after changing grippers.

name: DreamZero
zh: 从视频扩散骨干联合预测视觉未来和机器人动作。读结果要区分任务进度与完整成功，也要区分不同本体的检查点。
en: Use a video-diffusion backbone to jointly predict visual futures and actions. Distinguish task progress from complete success and compare the correct embodiment checkpoint.

name: GE-Act 2.0
zh: 先压缩保留控制所需信息，再单步预测视觉未来，用逆动力学反推动作。能达到同一画面的动作可能不止一条。
en: Compress control-relevant information, predict a visual future in one step and infer actions with inverse dynamics. More than one action can reach a similar image.

name: DreamTrue
zh: 用反事实动作和学习到的交互反馈修正视频预测。它研究动作遵从度，而非仅让画面逼真；预测成功仍需真机核对。
en: Use counterfactual actions and learned interaction feedback to improve action following, not just visual fidelity. Predicted success still needs real-world calibration.

name: Spatial-UMI-Dream
zh: 从 RGB-D 示范先学世界、再联合学视频、度量深度与动作。显式距离有助于区分看起来相同但够不着的物体；需要合适的传感数据。
en: Train first on the world, then jointly predict RGB, metric depth and actions from RGB-D demonstrations. Depth can distinguish apparent proximity from reachability, but requires suitable sensor data.

name: Phoenix
zh: 先学场景结构表征，再用于世界—动作模型；读跨平台成绩要核对每个基准的后训练，不能笼统称为零样本。
en: Learn scene-structure representations for world-action modeling. Check benchmark-specific post-training before interpreting cross-platform results as zero-shot.

name: A Survey on Vision-Language-Action Models for Embodied AI
zh: 从组件、控制策略和任务规划梳理 VLA；适合补齐政策路线，但不是另一次独立真机验证。
en: Use the component, control and planning taxonomy to orient a VLA reading list. A survey is not an independent robot trial.

name: A Comprehensive Survey on World Models for Embodied AI
zh: 按功能、时间建模、空间表征分轴比较。与本站按决策用途分组交叉阅读，避免把表征类型误当用途。
en: Compare functionality, temporal modeling and spatial representation. Cross this with the atlas's decision-role grouping rather than treating a representation as a use case.

name: Intelligence without representation
zh: 从在真实环境中运行的分层感知—行动行为出发，质疑必须先建统一内部表征的假设。它是设计立场，不是关于所有任务的定理。
en: Start with layers of situated sensor-to-action behavior rather than a single central representation. This is a design position, not a theorem about every task.

name: Deep Visual Foresight
zh: 给视频预测器不同的电机指令，用预测的像素运动挑选推物轨迹，再从新图像重规划。这里画面的用途是选动作。
en: Condition a video predictor on candidate motor commands, use predicted pixel motion to select a push and replan from a new image. The image is useful because it changes the action choice.

name: The Feeling of Success
zh: 比较视觉、触觉及二者结合对抓取结果的预测。它预测成功事件，不生成整段未来，展示了比视频更窄但有用的预测目标。
en: Compare vision, touch and their combination for predicting grasp outcomes. This event predictor illustrates a narrower target than a video; it is not a general simulator.

name: UniPi
zh: 给定当前图像与任务文本，先生成一段期望的视频，再从帧间变化提取可执行动作。视觉计划是接口，不是电机命令。
en: Generate a desired video trajectory from an image and instruction, then extract controls from the frame transitions. A visual plan is an interface, not a motor command.

name: SuSIE
zh: 图像编辑器提出子目标；单独训练的目标条件策略用当前观测去实现它。可把子目标不可达与执行器失手分开诊断。
en: An image editor supplies intermediate goals to a separately trained goal-conditioned policy. Test subgoal reachability separately from execution given a reachable goal.

name: GR-1
zh: 用视频生成预训练时序主干，再在机器人数据上预测未来图像与动作。共同训练不等于部署时搜索多条候选轨迹。
en: Pretrain on video generation, then predict future images and robot actions with a shared sequence model. Joint training does not imply searching competing futures at deployment.

name: Unified World Models
zh: 在共享 Transformer 中给动作和视频使用独立扩散时间步。改变已知量和去噪目标，同一系统可充当策略、前向或逆动力学模型。
en: Independent noise schedules for video and action in a shared transformer let the same system operate as a policy, forward dynamics or inverse dynamics by changing the conditioning.

name: Fast-WAM
zh: 训练保留未来视频监督，动作推理跳过未来视频采样。该组消融区分了训练表征收益与执行时想象成本，并未证明所有任务都不需要在线预测。
en: Retain future-video supervision but omit future-video sampling at execution. The ablations distinguish training benefits from runtime imagination, not a universal rule that foresight is unnecessary.

name: SWAM
zh: 研究加入动作学习后如何保持语言与视频对齐，并在固定训练预算下比较数据混合。三项实机任务的结果不是对任意数据规模或本体的保证。
en: Study how action learning affects language–video alignment and compare data mixtures at a fixed training budget. The three physical tasks do not establish a universal scaling law.

name: ζ0
zh: 训练教师读取实录未来的视觉特征和关节轨迹，部署只用预测的未来表征。作者在两个策略基座上评测；这不是只凭视觉就能保证人形控制的结论。
en: A training teacher uses recorded visual and body futures; deployment uses predicted future features instead. Results on two policy bases are not a guarantee of general humanoid control.
